items.description: Introduce commercial and open source tools for memory acquisition.
items.title: Memory Acquisition
LiME
items.description: (Not actively maintained 😵🍋‍🟩) - A Loadable Kernel Module (LKM) which allows for volatile memory acquisition from Linux and Linux-based devices, such as Android.

items.title: AVML
items.description: AVML is an X86_64 userland volatile memory acquisition tool written in Rust, intended to be deployed as a static binary.

items.title: Winpmem
items.description: WinPmem has been the default open source memory acquisition driver for windows for a long time.

items.title: varc
items.description: Volatile Artifact Collector gathers a snapshot of volatile data from a system.

items.title: fmem
items.description: This module creates /dev/fmem device, that can be used for dumping physical memory, without limits of /dev/mem (1MB/1GB, depending on distribution).

items.title: EVTXtract
items.description: EVTXtract recovers and reconstructs fragments of EVTX log files from raw binary data, including unallocated space and memory images.

items.title: Volatility3 Inodes Plugin
items.description: The plugin is a pushed verion of the lsof plugin extracting inode metadata information from each files.

items.title: Volatility3 Prefetch Plugin
items.description: The plugin is scanning, extracting and parsing Windows Prefetch files from Windows XP to Windows 11.
Introduce commercial and open source tools for memory analysis.

items.title: Volatility
items.description: The Volatility Framework is a completely open collection of tools, implemented in Python under the GNU General Public License, for the extraction of digital artifacts from volatile memory (RAM) samples.

items.title: Volatility3
items.description: Volatility is the world's most widely used framework for extracting digital artifacts from volatile memory (RAM) samples.

items.title: MemProcFS
items.description: The Memory Process File System (MemProcFS) is an easy and convenient way of viewing physical memory as files in a virtual file system.

items.title: Rekall
items.description: A new branch within the Volatility project was created to explore how to make the code base more modular, improve performance, and increase usability. (Deprecated)

items.title: Volafox
items.description: macOS Memory Analysis Toolkit' is developed on Python 2.x (Deprecated)

items.title: dwarf2json
items.description: Go utility that processes files containing symbol and type information to generate Volatilty3 Intermediate Symbol File (ISF) JSON output suitable for Linux and macOS analysis.
